nodes.label: AIRRt Dialect
nodes.description: Runtime dialect used as intermediate lowering target from AIR dialect before final lowering to LLVM.

nodes.label: aircc.py
nodes.description: Compiler driver taking AIR MLIR dialect as input, producing AIE binaries + host library code. Supports both AIE and GPU targets.

nodes.label: air-to-aie pass
nodes.description: Translates AIR dialect to AIE dialect. Generates AIE module per partition, routes channels through switch boxes, configures SHIM DMA.

nodes.label: air-to-std pass
nodes.description: Generates AIRRt dialect from AIR dialect as part of control code lowering.

nodes.label: airrt-to-llvm pass
nodes.description: Lowers AIRRt dialect to LLVM dialect.
